# 👋 Welcome to MailHub Discussions!

Welcome to the **MailHub** community! 🎉 

We're thrilled to have you here. Whether you are self-hosting MailHub for your personal mailboxes, deploying it across your team's organization workspace, or contributing to the codebase, this is the place to connect, ask questions, share ideas, and help shape the future of MailHub.

---

## 🧭 What is MailHub?

**MailHub** is an open-source, multi-tenant email management platform designed to unify your email workflow. With support for standard **IMAP/SMTP**, **Gmail OAuth**, and **Microsoft/Outlook OAuth**, MailHub brings all your mailboxes into a clean, modern Next.js interface powered by high-performance background sync (BullMQ + Redis) and instant full-text search (Meilisearch).

---

## 💬 How to Use GitHub Discussions

We’ve organized our discussions into dedicated categories to help keep conversations structured:

- 📢 **[Announcements](https://github.com/kawing11a/mailhub/discussions/categories/announcements)** — Stay updated with major release notes, security updates, and community news.
- 💡 **[Ideas & Feature Requests](https://github.com/kawing11a/mailhub/discussions/categories/ideas)** — Have an idea for a feature or UI improvement? Pitch it here and vote on ideas proposed by others.
- ❓ **[Q&A / Help](https://github.com/kawing11a/mailhub/discussions/categories/q-a)** — Need help setting up Docker Compose, configuring OAuth providers, or troubleshooting? Ask the community here!
- 🙌 **[Show and Tell](https://github.com/kawing11a/mailhub/discussions/categories/show-and-tell)** — Built a customized integration, plugin, or deployment setup with MailHub? Show off your build!
- 💬 **[General](https://github.com/kawing11a/mailhub/discussions/categories/general)** — For anything else related to MailHub and open-source email tooling.
